author: reek
body: The HDA audio driver's tone generator, checked by reading the PCM buffer back -- deterministic and silent, so it runs in the battery without a sound card and without codex-vm's synchronous stream drain (which blocks until the host has played the buffer). The actual playback path, hda-play-tone, drives the stream registers over MMIO and is heard on the speakers; it is exercised by hand, not here.
